hero.name: Kalid Muhumed
hero.intro: I'm a computer engineer and fullstack developer building scalable web applications, smart workflow automations, and AI integrations.

about.title: Background, education & skills
paragraphs: I'm Kalid Muhumed — a fullstack developer focused on automation. I build web apps in Next.js and connect them with Python services, APIs, and webhooks so manual steps become reliable flows.
Whether it's a dashboard, a lead pipeline, or a nightly sync between systems, I want the result to feel simple for the user and solid under the hood.
Right now I'm working on projects where interfaces, data, and automated workflows meet — from prototype to something you can trust in production.

education.title: Data / networking & systems development
education.detail: A practical focus on networks, data flows, and modern web stacks — building solutions that hold up in production.

education.title: Automation & integrations
education.detail: Deep dives into n8n, webhooks, and Python-based flows that remove manual steps between systems.

about.skillsIntro: Tech stack grouped by how I actually work.

projects.title: Selected projects
projects.intro: A selection of fullstack and automation projects — from webhook pipelines to dashboards that hold business flows together.

featured.title: AI Tenant Chat — Städhjälpen Väst
featured.description: Multi-tenant AI chat widget. This demo runs tenant-id stadhjalpen with auto-play: the visitor types in the input field, the AI replies with a typing indicator — a booking dialog for home cleaning in Gothenburg.
featured.hint: Open the widget (or reload the page) to play the conversation once.

items.title: Order Sync Hub
items.description: Fullstack dashboard that syncs Shopify and WooCommerce orders into one view, with webhook retries and Slack alerts when a sync fails.

items.title: Lead Intake Automator
items.description: n8n + Next.js pipeline that cleans form leads, enriches them via API, and routes hot prospects to CRM with a review queue for the team.

items.title: Invoice Flow
items.description: Automation that turns approved time entries into PDF invoices, posts them to Fortnox, and emails clients — with a Tailwind admin UI.

items.title: Site Monitor Bot
items.description: Uptime and content-change monitor for client sites. Stores checks in SQLite, exposes a status page, and pages on-call via Discord.
